Karthik — thanks for kicking this off. See below and attached for the packing manifest. I've kept quantities conservative and noted items that require explicit labeling.

Packing manifest (summary):
- Demo racks: 2 (each with 1x server box, 1x switch) — heavy, palletize recommended
- Laptops for demos: 4 (fully charged; 2 spare chargers)
- USB microphones: 6 (foam windshields in separate pouch)
- Power strips / surge protectors: 3
- Printed workshop guides: 80 copies (double-sided, stapled)
- Swag boxes: 80 (hoodie + sticker pack) — in flat mailers inside crate
- Quick-start sheets: 80 (laminated)

Handling notes:
- All batteries installed in devices must be marked; for regulators we should mark "Devices with lithium batteries" on the manifest. Greenbox, please confirm you can handle U.S. domestic ground shipments with that label.
- Attachments: packing_list_Stellar_20260315.pdf, demo_manifest_stellar.csv, swag_label_sheet_Stellar.xlsx

Onsite contacts: 
- Primary: Javier Ortega (Stellar) +1 617-555-1290
- Secondary: Alicia Ramos (Stellar) +1 617-555-1219

I can drop the crate at the SF staging bay on Monday morning (3/22) or coordinate a morning pickup if Greenbox needs us to hand it off earlier. Karthik — I'll also bring an extra set of printed guides in my carry-on just in case the crate is delayed.

—Marissa
